page.title: Settings
page.purpose: Change what applies everywhere — appearance, meal artwork, generation permission and usage, integrations, notifications, units and time, data and exports, and account — with an honest capability state for each.

priorities.statement: Appearance offers Light, Evening, and Follow device, and a change applies at once without touching food data.
Meal artwork presentation and image generation permission are separate controls; generation is Off unless the person opts in, with usage and budget visible.
Data & exports holds backups, recipe collections, printable weeks and groceries, CSV, and staged import in one place.
Integrations such as personal-planner say whether they are connected, pending, or unavailable, never a dead switch.
Units, currency, timezone, and week start are explicit and editable.
Data health lists actionable findings from the real diagnostics service, not a single score.

states.description: All sections with their current values; phones show summary rows that drill into sub-screens.
First read of the page's data; stable skeletons reserve the layout so nothing shifts on arrival, and no sample food is shown as saved data.
Some contributing data is unknown or could not be read; what is missing is named rather than shown as zero.
A write is in flight; the affected control shows a busy state and says why it is unavailable, and success appears only after the durable save.
The request failed; the reason and the next action are stated, pending edits are kept, and nothing is edited against a fake empty account.
Input was rejected; the offending field is identified next to it and every other edit is preserved.
The client cannot reach the API; cached data, locally pending actions, and server-confirmed saves are distinguished and unsupported actions say why.
No exports, integrations, or data-health findings exist yet; each section says so plainly instead of rendering blank.
Usage, integration status, or data-health values are older than their refresh window; their age is shown.
Generation is Off with an explanation of what opting in means.
Ask each time is on; a quote with variants and price or credit estimate appears before any job starts.
No image capability is configured; the control is disabled with an explanation.
personal-planner is not configured; untimed internal prep tasks keep working.
An export finished; a visible download link and retry are shown.
A staged import shows counts, format, duplicates, conflicts, and errors before any write.
Restore everything shows its impact and checkpoint and waits for explicit confirmation.
Data health lists actionable findings such as stale prices or unresolved ingredients.

claims.statement: Changing appearance changes presentation only and never alters recipes, servings, plans, or starts generation.
Meal artwork presentation and generation permission are separate controls.
Generation starts Off and explains what opting in does.
Ask each time shows the requested variants and estimate before a job starts.
An unconfigured capability is disabled with an explanation, never a dead control.
personal-planner shows its real state and untimed prep keeps working when it is not configured.
Import shows a review before any live write.
Restore everything requires explicit confirmation with its impact and checkpoint.
A finished export offers a visible download link and retry.
Data health reads the diagnostics service; a failure shows an error, never an empty healthy panel.
On phones sections are summary rows that open sub-screens instead of one long wall of fields.
Every section and control is keyboard reachable with visible focus in both appearances.
Light and Evening change palette and artwork only; the recipe, servings, dates, occurrences, layout, and actions are identical.
